name: omnetics-nano-36
notes: Omnetics Nano, 36 positions in two rows of 18, with a guide post at each end of each row (drawn as GUIDE cells, so a face is 2 x 20). The four symmetric guide posts let it mate both ways (reference and rotated 180 degrees); on NeuroNexus packages and Intan headstages both ways keep GND on GND and REF on REF, but the channel map differs.
